area: testbed hardening: the restart proven end-to-end on real runs instead of synthetic events

find.report_claim: cycle 154 recorded the Enter restart as working, but every test in test_new_run.py injects a synthetic 'died' event or sets sim.wave directly, so no test ever played a run to a real end and restarted from it
find.live_evidence: two manual end-to-end probes were run first: a bot run cleared the campaign at frame 2486 (score 11560), the banner was allowed to expire, Enter restarted at tick 0 / wave 1 / score 0, and a further 1500 bot frames reached wave 3, 19 kills, score 3995, hp 88 with the profile still showing 1 run and 1 win; a second probe stood still until a real death at frame 539, Enter restarted, and the saved file kept the lose entry
find.consumer_evidence: the synthetic path cannot catch a restart that resets the wrong state or records a phantom run, because it never passes through the real death and victory handlers orderings
